preconditions.description: Number of wood planks in the fence.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= hi <= 10**9 for hi in heights)
all(1 <= li <= ri <= n for li, ri in queries)
preconditions.description: Boundaries of the i-th piece of the fence.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in output)
postconditions.description: Each output is a non-negative integer representing the number of matching pieces.
